title: Traffic Plan Announced for Annual Raiwind Ijtima
excerpt: Lahore Traffic Police releases a traffic plan for the annual Raiwind Ijtima 2026, including designated entry routes and parking.
body_html: Lahore Traffic Police has released a comprehensive traffic plan for the annual Raiwind Ijtima 2026. The newly announced arrangement details specific entry routes and parking locations to manage the flow of attendees and vehicles during the event.
